requirements.name: Article 10 Data and data governance
requirements.description: 2. Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

requirements.name: Article 12 Record-keeping
requirements.description: 1. High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.

requirements.name: Article 14 Human oversight
requirements.description: 1. High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.

requirements.name: Article 15 Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
requirements.description: 5. High-risk AI systems shall be resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities.
